text: Welcome everyone. In this product roadmap sync we will review the enterprise SSO launch requirements.
We decided to require SAML 2.0 with Okta for Q4 enterprise customers and defer SCIM provisioning to Q1.
Carol, please draft the SAML security architecture specification by November 15th.
Understood. Notice that enterprise customers might reject self-signed IdP metadata without valid TLS certificates.
Good point. We should also investigate if multi-tenant isolation supports separate IdP discovery.
